description: Regional Transportation Planning Agencies (RTPA) is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The RTPA polygon feature class provides California Regional Transportation Planning Agencies (RTPA) legislative boundaries, primarily for regional planning applications. The list of California RegionalTransportation Planning Agencies is current as of February, 2014, provided by Division of Transportation Planning, Office of Regional and Interagency Planning. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are RTPA Boundaries, Caltrans, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData, CalSTA, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -124.4098,32.5343,-114.1308,42.0095. The hub shows 2025-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the hub listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
